book.title: Salsa Cookbook
book.subtitle: A Farmer's Guide to Homemade Salsa
book.welcome.heading: Welcome to the Salsa Kitchen!
book.welcome.paragraph1: A good salsa brings a little brightness, sweetness, or heat to the table. This cookbook gathers the recipes developed for Salsa Valley, from familiar tomato salsa to more unusual fruit-filled combinations.
book.welcome.paragraph2: Each recipe lists the ingredients and the amount needed. Gather everything before you begin, then let the cooking begin!
